title: Pickle Eye Surreal Portrait
description: A vibrant surreal painting shows a green-skinned woman in profile with elaborate hair, facing a giant stylized eye. The eye contains a swirling vortex landscape of pine trees under a setting sun, while large green pickles with water droplets float below. Leafy foliage and a smaller blue face appear in the swirling sky above.
prompt: surreal psychedelic painting of a lime green woman in profile with intricate hair and leaves, gazing at an enormous stylized eye that contains a swirling vortex of pine forest and a glowing sunset.
